files.name: motion-prompt-087.txt
PROMPT.md
files.content:
Please use "Before/after slider" (ビフォーアフタースライダー), one of the names in "Landing page & web effects".
Motion Prompt #087

What it is: Drag a divider to compare before and after
What the sample shows: Dragging the line in the middle of the photo left and right changes how much of the grey "before" (left) and the coloured "after" (right) is shown.
Spec:
- Photo frame 359 × 140 (radius 10). Right: the edited photo in colour. Left: the same photo as the "before" (saturation removed, navy at 0.18 opacity on top).
- The before image is clipped to the left of the divider. On the divider: a white line (3 wide) and a white circle (radius 17) with left/right arrows.
- At 0.7 s the circle is grabbed; the divider goes 50%→20% (0.75–1.55 s) →82% (1.55–2.65 s) →50% (2.65–3.55 s), all cubic ease-in-out.
- Released at 3.62 s. Labels BEFORE (top left) and AFTER (top right).
When to use it: Use it on pages that sell a change: renovation, beauty, photo retouching.

Reference implementation (Canvas 2D, a function whose picture depends only on the time): https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/en/e/087.txt
Shared helper code: https://showheyohtaki.github.io/motion-prompt/api/v1/kit/lp.js
Keep the shapes, timing and easing values of the reference implementation as they are, and change only the text, colours and assets to fit what I am making.
